description:
Make our gripper attach to the Seeed reBot Arm B601-RS (gripper motor: RobStride RS00; see AGENTS.md hardware section and the Gripper N / Handle N / Base N scheme). Design the mounting interface so the latest gripper base (Base 9, voice-d96cd30d, built on Base 8; if a newer Base exists when you claim this, build on the latest) bolts onto the arm's wrist / end-effector flange in place of the stock reBot gripper. Use Seeed's reBot-DevArm repo (https://github.com/Seeed-Projects/reBot-DevArm) for the B601_RS hardware CAD and the stock gripper's mount, and match its bolt pattern and how the stock gripper mounts. Deliver a parameterized adapter (or an integrated mount on the base, whichever is cleaner) that prints without supports, with the RS00 cabling (CAN and power) routed cleanly. Don't break existing Base versions; this becomes the next Base N per the scheme. 

SCOPE EXPANSION (Jake, 2026-10-20):
Step 1 — Arm CAD: see whether CAD exists for the reBot Arm (bought from Seeed Studio), e.g. STEP or STL files in Seeed-Projects/reBot-DevArm under hardware/reBot_B601_RS. Bring it into the repo with its source URL and license noted, converted to something the live preview and OpenSCAD can use, so the arm shows in the live preview.
Step 2 — Dual end-effector mount: design a mount base on the arm's end flange that takes BOTH pieces of hardware Jake will have: (a) our two-finger gripper (latest Base) and (b) the Aero Hand (the left-handed Aero Hand already in use; find its CAD and mounting in this repo or the aero_hand project). Ideally one common arm-side flange adapter with swappable tool-side interfaces, or a quick-change, so either end effector can be mounted. Keep everything parameterized and printable without supports.
summary: Design a parameterized, support-free printable mount that bolts the gripper's next Base onto the Seeed reBot B601-RS wrist flange, with RS00 cabling routed. Also import the arm CAD into the live preview, and make one common flange adapter with swappable tool interfaces for the gripper and left Aero Hand.
